description: A venue operations director must authorize an overnight film shoot in a historic theater and finalize the equipment-entry, floor-protection, wrap-time, and insurance arrangements.

shared_context.S1: A production plans to film several interior scenes in the historic Calder Theater on Thursday night.
shared_context.S2: The draft production plan calls for equipment to enter through the freight elevator, 24 crew members to work in the theater, ordinary floor covering, and a 12:00 AM wrap.
shared_context.S3: Morgan has authority to approve or reject the theater booking and its operating conditions.
shared_context.S4: Before issuing the venue authorization, Morgan conducts the production's routine location-and-insurance signoff with the location manager and insurance coordinator.

PF1.text: Leah's site inspection found that the freight elevator is unavailable on Thursday. The south loading door is the approved alternative, but its rolling equipment limit requires the production's equipment to be divided into exactly three loads, and rigid panels must cover the historic parquet floor. Leah completed the inspection this morning, but the written site memo is still in her location file.

PF2.text: Andre confirmed by email with the insurer this afternoon that coverage applies only if the shoot wraps by exactly 10:30 PM and the certificate of insurance names Calder Theater as an additional insured. Andre also confirmed that the certificate has already been filed with that additional-insured designation, but he has not yet entered the insurer's conditions and certificate status in the production clearance log.

acceptance_conditions: The theater shoot must be authorized.
Equipment must enter through the south loading door.
Equipment must be divided into exactly three loads.
Rigid panels must be installed to protect the parquet floor.
The shoot must wrap at exactly 10:30 PM.
The certificate of insurance must name Calder Theater as an additional insured.
A location-protection commitment mentioning rigid panels must be logged.
An insurance commitment mentioning the certificate and Calder Theater must be logged.

content_checks.C4: decisions['floor_protection'] in ['rigid panels', 'rigid panels over historic parquet floor']
content_checks.C7: any(('rigid panel' in c['detail'] or 'Rigid panel' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('certificate' in c['detail'] or 'Certificate' in c['detail']) and 'Calder Theater' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The unavailable freight elevator changes equipment entry to the south loading door, fixes the equipment division at exactly three loads, and changes floor protection to rigid panels with a corresponding commitment.

The insurer's verified condition changes the wrap from the draft midnight time to exactly 10:30 PM, establishes that the filed certificate names Calder Theater as an additional insured, and requires an insurance-record commitment.
